sources.title: FIPS 203 · ML-KEM
sources.excerpt: ML-KEM establishes shared secret key material. A key-encapsulation mechanism does not supply digital signatures or authenticate an endpoint by itself.

sources.title: FIPS 204 · ML-DSA
sources.excerpt: ML-DSA is a digital signature standard. Its use requires compatible signing and verifying implementations and an authenticated public-key distribution policy.

sources.title: RFC 8446 · TLS 1.3
sources.excerpt: TLS key establishment and certificate authentication are separate functions. A negotiated key-exchange group alone does not establish the properties of certificate signatures.

sources.title: EIP-712 · Typed structured signatures
sources.excerpt: Typed structured signatures need application-level replay prevention. ECDAT binds the exact proposal, domain, nonce and expiry before consuming a reviewer decision.
